---
description: "Use when writing user flows, wireframe descriptions, UX research, or design-system guidance in docs/ux-ui/ or apps/mockup/."
applyTo: ["docs/ux-ui/**", "apps/mockup/**"]
---
# UX/UI documents

- Flows go in `docs/ux-ui/flows/flow-<journey-name>.md`, using `template-user-flow.md` and linking the related PRD and epic with the same feature slug.
- Describe every screen with its empty, loading, error, and success states.
- Include accessibility notes: keyboard navigation, labels, announcements, and contrast.
- Reuse components and patterns already documented in `docs/ux-ui/design-system/` before proposing new ones.
- List constraints the Dev Agent must respect, and record unresolved product decisions as open questions for the Product Manager.
